strapiBlog.title: Exclusive Branded Residences Coming Soon to Emaar Beachfront!
strapiBlog.short_description: Picture this: the sun rising over the tranquil waters of the Arabian Gulf, the golden hues dancing across your private beach, and the skyline of Palm Jumeirah standing majestic in the distance. This isn’t a dream—it’s your reality at Emaar Beachfront.

data.text:
Picture this: the sun rising over the tranquil waters of the Arabian Gulf, the golden hues dancing across your private beach, and the skyline of Palm Jumeirah standing majestic in the distance. This isn’t a dream—it’s your reality at the Emaar Beachfront’s upcoming branded waterfront residences, The Bristol.

A sanctuary of beachfront living in Dubai, this masterpiece by Emaar offers more than just a residence. It’s a lifestyle, a statement, and a gateway to everything you’ve ever desired in luxury living. From the sophisticated interiors inspired by nature to the iconic landmarks just a stone’s throw away, Emaar Beachfront redefines what it means to call Dubai home.

What to Expect from Emaar Beachfront?

The elegant apartments at The Bristol will offer residents an exclusive slice of paradise, with direct access to a 2-km private beach and proximity to world-class landmarks like Dubai Marina.

This tower by Emaar will include 1- to 4-bedroom apartments and exclusive 5-bedroom penthouses. With spacious layouts and unobstructed views, every apartment at Emaar’s Branded Waterfront Residences is designed to elevate your living experience.

Tower Highlights

  • 44 Storeys are divided into distinct sections.
  • 8-story Podium: Hosts hotel amenities, management offices, and parking.
  • Ground Floor: Features lobbies for branded residences and hotels. BOH services are discretely positioned to enhance the aesthetics.
  • Hotel Floors: Occupy the lowest 10 levels above the podium.
  • Branded Residences: They are spread across 30 upper floors, with utility services on floors 12 and 35 arranged in a logical arrangement.

Unit Types at The Bristol

  • 1-Bedroom Apartments – 825 sq. ft.
  • 2-Bedroom Apartments – 1,459 sq. ft.
  • 3-Bedroom Apartments – 1,912 sq. ft.
  • 4-Bedroom Apartments – 2,501 sq. ft.
  • 5-Bedroom Penthouses – 5,828 sq. ft.

Emaar Beachfront’s private beach residences in Dubai stand out as a unique offering. They offer direct access to the shoreline and proximity to high-end dining and entertainment options.

Expression of Interest (EOI)

Secure your dream home at Emaar Beachfront by registering your interest starting December 13, 2024.

Why Invest in Emaar Beachfront?

1. Prime Location

Strategically located in Dubai Harbour between Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) and Palm Jumeirah, Emaar Beachfront offers easy connectivity to Dubai’s most vibrant hubs, including Dubai Marina and Sheikh Zayed Road. This ensures that residents enjoy a peaceful retreat without compromising on accessibility.

2. Unparalleled Views

Wake up to breathtaking vistas of Palm Jumeirah, the sparkling Arabian Gulf, and Dubai’s iconic skyline. Each apartment is positioned to maximize natural light and showcase these stunning panoramas.

3. World-Class Amenities

Emaar Beachfront is designed to cater to every lifestyle need:

  • 2-km Private Beach for residents.
  • Yacht Club for marine enthusiasts.
  • Infinity Pool, Kids’ Pool, and Kids’ Play Area.
  • Signature F&B Outlets for culinary indulgence.
  • Spa and Wellness Facilities for rejuvenation.
  • State-of-the-Art Gym to maintain an active lifestyle.

4. Spacious and Elegant Apartments

Whether you’re seeking a cozy one-bedroom retreat or a lavish four-bedroom haven, apartments at Emaar Beachfront offer a range of layouts to suit diverse preferences. The interiors, inspired by nature, exude warmth, sophistication, and timeless charm.

faqs.question: What makes Emaar Beachfront unique compared to other luxury developments?

data.answer: Emaar Beachfront offers exclusive features like a 2-km private beach, direct access to Dubai Marina, unobstructed views of The Palm Island, and world-class amenities, making it a standout option for beachfront living in Dubai.

faqs.question: What types of apartments are available, and what are their starting prices?

data.answer:
Emaar Beachfront offers:

  • 1-Bedroom Apartments from AED 500,000.
  • 2-Bedroom Apartments from AED 900,000.
  • 3-Bedroom Apartments from AED 1.3M.
  • 4-Bedroom Apartments from AED 1.5M.
It is located at Dubai Harbour, offering proximity to Dubai Marina and other iconic landmarks while providing a serene beachfront environment.

faqs.question: What amenities are available for residents at The Bristol?

data.answer: Residents will enjoy a private beach, a yacht club, an infinity pool, a kids’ pool and play area, signature F&B outlets, spa and wellness facilities, and a state-of-the-art gym.

faqs.question: What is the appeal of Dubai luxury beachfront apartments like those at Emaar Beachfront?

data.answer: These apartments offer the perfect mix of luxury, exclusivity, and convenience. With unobstructed views, high-end amenities, and prime location, they are ideal for both personal use and investment.
